history.summary: This is the Davangere temple of Goddess Vasavi Kanyaka Parameshwari, run by the Sri Kannikaparameshwari Devasthana Sangha at SKP Road, Shivaji Nagar, Davangere-577001 (listed on the Karnataka Arya Vysya Mahasabha's eSeva portal, which offers free darshan booking for the 'Davangere Vasavi Temple'). Vasavi is the kuladevata of the Arya Vysya community: per the Vasavi legend recorded in the Vasavi Puranamulu, she was the daughter of Kusuma Shresthi of Penugonda (Andhra Pradesh); when King Vishnu Vardhana sought to marry her by force, Vasavi and 102 couples of the Vysya gotras entered the sacrificial fire (Agni Pravesam) to uphold dharma and non-violence, and she emerged as Kanyaka Parameshwari, an incarnation of Adiparashakti. The Davangere shrine serves the city's Vysya community; no published founding date, architectural details, or festival calendar specific to the Davangere temple were found - the festivals listed are the community-wide observances (verify locally). CSV town/state (Davangere, Karnataka) are correct.

name: Sri Vasavi Kanyakaparameshwari Temple
town_description: Davangere (Davanagere) is a major city in central Karnataka, historically a prosperous cotton-textile centre under the Mysore Wodeyars and famous for its benne (butter) dosa. The Vasavi temple stands on SKP Road in Shivaji Nagar (Davangere 577001), close to the city centre and the Durgambika temple locality.
